# Every Line Item

> Line-item cost breakdowns for California ADUs — every phase priced so you can see where the money goes.

Site: https://everylineitem.com/

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://everylineitem.com/): Series overview and featured posts
- [Compare builds](https://everylineitem.com/compare/): Side-by-side six-phase ADU cost comparison (default 800 vs 400 sq ft)
- [Methodology](https://everylineitem.com/methodology/): How figures are built (public sources; no paywalled RSMeans)
- [About](https://everylineitem.com/about/): Why six phases
- [Worksheet](https://everylineitem.com/worksheet/): Blank six-phase CSV ledger
- [Benchmarks](https://everylineitem.com/benchmarks/): Regional phase ranges
- [Corrections](https://everylineitem.com/corrections/): Change log
- [Privacy](https://everylineitem.com/privacy/)
